blind.description: A freestanding weathered stone architectural column. It features a square stepped stone base, a rounded toroidal base ring, a cylindrical shaft built from curved stone blocks, and an ornamental capital with carved petal-like motifs supporting a square flat stone top slab divided into four quadrants. Surfaces are solid, smooth-contoured, and textured with weathered grey stone with greenish moss accents.
blind.from_above: A square flat stone surface divided by cross-shaped seams into four equal square tiles.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the figure (around 6.5 to 7 feet tall), with a square footprint about half the figure's height wide.
